values.note: 'Campsites are on a first come, first serve basis. There is no reservation system.' Pay at the pay station. Stays limited to 14 consecutive days within a 30-day period; no seasonal or residential camping.

hookups.source: https://www.nortonva.gov/467/Campground ('18 single units with electrical hookups'; 'RV tanks may be filled with water using centrally located water spigots, but may not remain hooked up'; 'Discharge of gray water and sewage prohibited. Please use dump station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 18 single units with electrical hookups (amperage not stated), each with a parking spur, tent pad, picnic table and fire pit with grill; up to 8 people and 3 motorized vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://www.nortonva.gov/467/Campground ('an 18-site campground', 'The campground offers 18 single units with electrical hookups'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.nortonva.gov/467/Campground ('hot showers, flush toilets, and central water fountains', 'centrally located water spigots', 'Please use dump station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'Open annually spring-fall. Specific dates for opening and closing the campground are dependent on the weather but typically the campground will be open from May-October.'

summary: Confirmed $20/night (fees left as recorded), first come first served with no reservations, water spigots and dump station, closed winters. Added 14-day limit, 18 sites with electric hookups (amps not stated), no water or sewer at the sites, hot showers and flush toilets, season typically May-October.
